description: 정보통신산업진흥원_SW연구성과정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 정보통신산업진흥원. 국가연구개발사업을 통해 창출된 소프트웨어 성과에 대한 기술상세정보(기술/개발/품질/제품)입니다. 관리항목: SW개요, 경쟁력, 등록특허 및 표준, 기술이전 실적 및 방법, 개발목표, 타겟고객 및 시장, 세부구성기술, 개발기간 및 소요공수, 개발환경, 적용표준, 개발관리 및 적용방법론, 테스트 기준, 테... The portal shows 2025-09-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
